method: Manual semantic review of the same six questions before and after; HTTP success alone is not correctness. No aggregate accuracy benchmark claim from six turns.

criteria.specialization: Correctly describes Azure AI / enterprise AI / agents with published evidence.
criteria.clients: Names real organizations or projects; does not claim authorship or client work for products only discussed in writing.
criteria.sql_experience: Finds relevant SQL-agent article/work rather than unsupported abstention.
criteria.article_summary: Covers complex on-prem SQL problem, explorer-first approach, safeguards and lessons. Note omission of Security CTE Prefix/read-only validation as incomplete.
criteria.conversation_summary: Summarizes actual preceding conversation; distinguishes earlier claims from independently verified facts.
criteria.first_question: Recalls exact first question without adding unsupported client assertions.
